title: Wind transitions and oxygen recovery
query:
Investigate how changes in summer wind conditions relate to the development and dissipation of bottom-water hypoxia off the Pearl River Estuary in 2011. Distinguish changes in vertical stratification from horizontal displacement of low-oxygen water.

Independently identify relevant literature and appropriate methods. Deliver an evidence-based report, supporting figures, and one executable analysis notebook. Distinguish demonstrated results from mechanisms that the supplied data cannot establish.
